_comment: Semantic versions for the hand-written player-facing content that documents
the game: the instruction booklet and the /play load-screen cards.
WHY SEMVER AND NOT A GIT SHA: a hash tells you WHICH build shipped, but two
hashes cannot be compared — you cannot look at ec589de and 146964d and say
which is newer or how far apart they are. Version numbers sort, so 'the cards
are 1.0.0 and the booklet is 1.4.0' is a fact you can read at a glance.
verifiedAgainst is the claim that matters: the game build whose behaviour
someone actually re-read this content against. When the deployed game moves
past it, the content is not wrong — it is UNVERIFIED, which is a different
and more honest thing to say. Both surfaces show that state rather than
major - the content was restructured (chapters added/removed/reordered)
minor - a mechanic's description changed, or content was added
patch - wording, typos, a figure swap; nothing a player learns differently
Bump verifiedAgainst ONLY after re-reading against that build. It is meant
to take deliberate effort; that friction is the whole point.

manual.note: Initiative trigger, turn economy, status stacking, combat log, controller + battle speed, Mother Slime reach, auto-save indicator, Cure vs Mugwort.

cards.note: Rewritten as short snippets from the booklet's Hints chapter; AP removed (retired from the game); Episode One content only.
